description: Splunk Enterprise / Splunk Cloud scheduled search alert sent with the 'Slack Notification Alert' alert action (Splunkbase), including the first result's fields and a link to the results.
provenance: Splunk 'Slack Notification Alert' add-on docs: the message supports $name$, $result.<field>$, $results_link$ tokens and can attach the first result as fields with a link to the results; results links are <splunk>/app/search/@go?sid=<sid>; scheduled-search sids embed the scheduled time as '_at_<epoch seconds>_'. Message text is the alert's configured message.

event.text:
Splunk Alert: Checkout 5xx spike
412 checkout requests failed with 5xx in the last 5 minutes.
